sections.heading: Technical reports
sections.intro: My technical work examines the evaluation and security of AI systems that handle financial data. The current programme documents three studies on a single domain: the financial records of a goods distributor, comprising statements, invoices and payments. Each study is documented as a technical report with its evaluation data, cost per run, latency figures and documented failure modes, together with the code required to reproduce the results.

paper.statusBody: Status: {status}. This technical report documents the study design and current progress. Results, evaluation data and reproducibility materials will be added here when available. No results are reported until they have been measured.
